evals.prompt: 全部 skills 排名一下，别只看当前 Codex sessions，帮我确认有没有漏掉 Claude、Cursor、Hermes、OpenClaw 和编辑器日志。
evals.expected_output: Agent runs a discovery-first audit, separates primary and supplement roots, produces canonical ranking plus coverage notes, and does not merge noisy editor logs into main ranking without justification.

evals.prompt: 为什么这个 skill 的 wideMentions 特别高，但是 strictCalls 很低？这算命中率差吗？
evals.expected_output: Agent explains strictCalls versus wideMentions, identifies system-prompt/path/listing noise, and avoids treating wideMentions as real usage.

evals.prompt: 把这次技能命中率审计整理成主榜、补充榜、噪声榜，再给我哪些 skill 应该常驻、哪些该外置、哪些要改 description。
evals.expected_output: Agent returns a structured report with main ranking, supplemental/noise boundaries, and actionable recommendations grouped by resident, external/archive, description improvement, and alias normalization.
